en.headline: Free rare-animal exhibition opens at The Mills for Halloween
en.dek: The Mills says the Tales of the Crawlers show at Building 6 ground floor runs from Saturday to 1 November and includes species making their first public appearance in Hong Kong.
body: The Mills in Tsuen Wan has opened a free exhibition called Tales of the Crawlers in partnership with the Hong Kong Insect Education and Conservation Centre. It runs from 10 October to 1 November on the ground floor of Building 6.

Organisers say visitors can see animals that are rarely displayed, including an African pygmy mouse that weighs less than a five-dollar coin, a tree frog with a characteristic expression, a scorpion that fluoresces under ultraviolet light, and a blue-tongued skink. Some of the species are appearing in public in Hong Kong for the first time.

The exhibition is open daily from noon to 7pm. Guided tours are available on weekends and public holidays in the afternoon, and paid hands-on workshops with additional animals are also scheduled at those times. Admission to the main exhibition is free.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠免費怪奇動物展覽今日開幕
zh.dek: 南豐紗廠與香港昆蟲教育及科普中心合作，六廠地下「奇蟲物語」展覽由周六起至11月1日，部分物種首次在港公開展出。
body: 荃灣南豐紗廠今日起與香港昆蟲教育及科普中心合作，在六廠地下舉行免費的「奇蟲物語」展覽，展期至11月1日。
主辦單位表示，參觀者可近距離看到平日難得一見的生物，包括體重輕於五元硬幣的非洲侏儒鼠、表情獨特的老爺樹蛙、紫外光下會發螢光的帝王蠍，以及藍舌石龍子。部分物種更是香港首次公開亮相。
展覽每日中午12時至下午7時開放。周末及公眾假期下午設有導賞團，同場亦有收費的觸感工作坊，讓參加者近距離接觸更多動物。主展覽免費入場。
